[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-19T15:49:37+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2123443586876440903; média: videó, 114 másodperc]
A user asked Perplexity to find a suitable parcel of land for a 12-cabin build near Sacramento.

Perplexity found the @mireyehq API, spent $2.20 on 31 requests to Mireye's Land Search and Enrich API, and narrowed 327 parcels to 3 finalists by eliminating parcels with >15% slope, flood zones, wetland zones, or protected land.

Then Perplexity retrieved USGS 3DEP 1m elevation and NAIP aerial imagery, modeled each site in three.js, recommended a winning parcel, and created this 4K 60fps video to recap its process.
